title: Indonesia Marketplace Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily seller activity from a synthetic Indonesian online marketplace into clean-order and order-issue KPIs, 7-day order-cancellation risk scores, return rate anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on one governed platform.

talking_points: Clean order rate, order issues raised, cancelled orders and GMV in IDR for 40 sellers shipping from Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan and Makassar.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to seller-day rows.
The issue-type chart shows which issues end as cancelled orders and which are always resolved, such as courier network disruptions.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of marketplace KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which sellers should the quality team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each seller's probability of a cancelled order in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags return rate outliers per seller, and the forecast projects marketplace-wide order issues for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are our seller controls keeping up?

talking_points: Stock sync compliance, seller compliance document coverage and pending documents frame the control gaps.
Stock sync compliance against cancelled orders by seller shows where missed syncs and cancellations move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, seller, issue-type and risk tables only.
show: Stock sync compliance and document coverage
Stock sync compliance vs cancelled orders
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when an order runs into an issue right now?

talking_points: Live order events land in RAW.LIVE_ORDERS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ISSUE events with an SOP hint and the seller's current risk band, then emails the on-call analyst.
tabs.call_out: From order issue to seller case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic order-issue handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
